title: Flyover project awarded in Kolkata
excerpt: A flyover project with the West Bengal Housing Infrastructure Development Corporation, in Kolkata.
body: The group recorded a flyover project with the West Bengal Housing Infrastructure Development Corporation in Kolkata, dated February 2010.

Elevated road structures sit squarely in the civic category — commissioned by a public body, used by people who had no part in specifying them, and expected to remain in service far beyond the programme that delivered them.

This entry is drawn from the client's own published record. The project's scope, duration, current status and any figures attached to it have not been confirmed for publication here, and no value is stated deliberately.
